items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I do remember that I did sub for Harvey Boone in the Duke Ellington orchestra

ctx.x: say important in jazz annals and important to you. What were your relations, let's say, by this time, let's say, with Duke? I mean Duke was around there -- did you know him intimately or fairly well? Did you run in to him, did you play for him now and then on occasion? Up until, say, the early thirties.

I cannot say that I knew him intimately, but at one point I do remember, and someone has told me that they spoke to Duke about this and Duke doesn't remember it, but I guess I was sort of a little insignificant as a musician around Harlem at the time -- he had a saxophone player with him named Harvey Boon, and Harvey Boon became ill and if my memory serves me properly, the Ellington band was at a club on 57th Street called Harry Richman's Club, and I sat in for Harvey Boon for a week or two -- I'm not sure what…
